recorded_by: Primary assistant relays the one completed independent audit; this is not another audit or a repair.

findings.title: Checkpoint verification can be bypassed
findings.static_reproduction: Reconstruct an interrupted run with Run(..., resume=True), omit resume(checkpoint_path), and submit the next row through perform(). Construction checks the header and journal but collection has no checkpoint-verified prerequisite. Missing/corrupt checkpoint evidence need not block continuation.
findings.evidence: AST/source inspection: no checkpoint-verification call in construction or collection.

findings.title: Integrity violations are not retained or made terminal
findings.static_reproduction: Complete call 1, attempt call 3, catch SCHEDULE_POSITION_MISMATCH, then submit call 2. The exception creates neither an append-only integrity entry nor a self.events entry, so continuation remains possible. Duplicate/checkpoint exceptions have the same problem. Successful resume returns MACHINE_INTERRUPTION_WITH_SEALED_CHECKPOINT without recording the frozen INCOMPLETE event.
findings.evidence: Pilot tests exception rejection, not terminal event retention.

findings.title: Incorrect terminal verdict and incomplete integrated cell-state reporting
findings.static_reproduction: After 480 correct A observations, call final_report() before enter_b(). A passes but self.qualified is empty, producing NO_PHASE_A_CELL_QUALIFIED. Receipted failures leave cells scheduled instead of incomplete; failed A cells never become B_NOT_ELIGIBLE.
findings.evidence: Pilot transition tests cover the helper, not these integrated paths.

findings.title: Replay does not validate failure receipts or checkpoint lineage
findings.static_reproduction: Replace an isolated FAILURE receipt with null/another call's receipt and reseal the journal. Replay checks pending call and stored event category, not receipt validity. Changing and resealing a START checkpoint_lineage is also undetected.
findings.evidence: AST inspection found zero reads of receipt and checkpoint_lineage in _replay().

findings.title: Authorized B resume incorrectly requires an A grant first
findings.static_reproduction: Reconstruct a live-mode interrupted B run with a correctly bound B grant. Construction unconditionally calls _authorize('A') before replay discovers the phase and rejects the valid B grant.
findings.evidence: The full mechanical pilot interrupts/resumes A only.

findings.title: Manifest verification omits explicitly hashed artifacts
findings.static_reproduction: In an isolated view change corpus/validate_corpus.py, independent_contamination.py, validate_finalization.py or AUTHORING_CANDIDATES.json. These manifest-hashed files are absent from Package.pins and not inspected. Comparing candidate SHA text to a constant does not hash the candidate file.
findings.evidence: Verification does not meet the supplied all-manifest-artifact-hashes requirement.

independent_checks_performed.method: Read-only source/AST inspection and independent byte/schema recomputation; static defect traces were not executed through the harness.

limitations: Producer 2031-test PASS inspected, not independently rerun.
Producer contamination-failure test checks event inventory only.
Second-run equality is supported by the producer report; reviewer verified retained evidence against reported hashes, not a separately retained second tree.
Separate producer 1454 Git authority-byte comparisons were not duplicated by reviewer.
Live provider identity, option honoring, fresh sessions and runtime behavior were not tested.
